mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses equity discount rates by reducing the risk-free rate, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift capital from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as recession expectations rise.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in payroll growth (PAYEMS) and rises in unemployment (UNRATE) signal severe labor market contraction, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings face headwinds.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth is negative and UNRATE rises > 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index above 260 signals persistent inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the Federal Reserve maintains restrictive monetary policy to combat price pressures.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 260.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust residential construction activity, which signals strong consumer spending and corporate demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is above the 50th percentile of historical values.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production decline below 95.0 signals weakening manufacturing activity, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as recession risks intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly retail sales increase exceeding 0.5% signals strong consumer spending, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings growth accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS growth > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate increases above 4.5% and CPI inflation above 3.0% signal aggressive monetary tightening amid high inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as equity valuations face compression.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0.
